Market today:
The market is showing signs of warming up, with the volatility index hitting a year-to-date low. This positive sentiment is tied to bond market trust in Fed communication, despite hints that the Fed may still "have work to do." This stability could be a tailwind for your tech/chip names.

Your holdings:
SOXL is a major concern, down 56.25% and flagged SELL. Your new SPAL position is also deeply in the red at -38.81% and below its stop. Both are leveraged ETFs, and margin amplifies these drops significantly. SMH and QQQI are flagged TRIM and are near their stops.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on Treasury yields and the broader market's reaction to Fed commentary. Also, monitor your leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) closely for further decay and stop breaches.

Bottom line:
Prioritize managing risk in your leveraged positions, especially with your significant margin exposure.
plays: SOXL: Your SOXL is down 56.25% and flagged SELL. Consider exiting this leveraged position to cut losses, especially on margin.
SPAL: Your new SPAL position is down 38.81% and below its stop of 21.38. Review this leveraged ETF for an exit.
AAPL: Scanner shows a strong BUY setup for AAPL (10/12, daily discount). Entry 319.38-319.06, stop 318.57.
